library(crosstalk)

## Column {data-width=350}

### Filtros

```{r}
sd <- SharedData$new(datos, key = ~ID_Reserva)
filter_checkbox("ciudad", "Ciudad", sd, ~Ciudad, inline = TRUE)
filter_checkbox("tipo", "Tipo de alojamiento", sd, ~TipoAlojamiento, inline = TRUE)
filter_slider("precio", "Precio por noche (MXN)", sd,
              ~PrecioPorNoche, width = "100%")
```

### KPIs

```{r}
renderText({
  paste0("Reservas: ", nrow(sd$data(withSelection = TRUE)))
})
```

```{r}
renderText({
  d <- sd$data(withSelection = TRUE)
  paste0("Precio medio: $", round(mean(d$PrecioPorNoche, na.rm = TRUE)))
})
```

## Column {data-width=650}

### Precio por ciudad

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  d <- sd$data(withSelection = TRUE)
  ggplotly(
    ggplot(d, aes(Ciudad, PrecioPorNoche, fill = Ciudad)) +
      geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE, outlier.color = "red", alpha = .7) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "MXN")
  )
})
```

### Heatmap ciudad × tipo

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  d <- sd$data(withSelection = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(Ciudad, TipoAlojamiento) %>%
    summarise(p = mean(PrecioPorNoche, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  ggplotly(
    ggplot(d, aes(TipoAlojamiento, Ciudad, fill = p)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(p)), size = 3) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FEE0D2", high = "#A50F15") +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "MXN")
  )
})
```
